_about: The world. SI units (m, kg, s, rad). Every physical key has a _source sibling: measured | cited | derived | guess.

sim.solverIterations_source: measured with 56 balls + 2 rockers + robot: peak rocker drift 0.102 dps at 4 iterations, 0.053 at 8, 0.004 at 16, 0.003 at 24, costing 1.05/1.57/2.59/4.22 ms per frame. 16 buys a still rocker with ~380 fps of headroom.

ball.e_poly_source: guess - CALIBRATE. The single most consequential uncalibrated number for land rate: a hollow 26-hole ball hitting a thin polycarbonate skin loses far more than a solid ball would, and both flex. At the plan's 0.70 every shot that entered the CELL rebounded straight back out. Measure it with a 1 m drop onto a goal skin filmed at 60 fps.

hive.cgOffset_source: cad centroid, expressed in the ROCKER BODY frame (theta=0, the over-centre point). The CAD state (theta=-30.04) puts it 1.83 in above and 1.05 in toward the down-CELL; rotated to theta=0 that is 2.11 in straight up, +0.20 deg of residual asymmetry. Densities guessed - SWEEP
